title: Current Evidence Source Production
purpose: Turn W7 source-lane readiness into auditable current-source work orders and validated source candidates without creating claims, evidence, RRE readings or runtime positions.
validationRules: Dossier must exist in W7 readiness.
Every target lane must exist for that dossier.
Publisher, title, sourceId, sourceVersionOrDigest and retrievedAt are required.
authorityClassHint must be a known Current Web Authority class; it is still only a hint until CWA admission.
retrievedAt must not be later than the intake producedAt timestamp.
The same source may support more than one lane, but source IDs must remain globally unique inside the intake.
A source candidate is not a fact, claim, CURRENT_DATA or admitted evidence.
